pages.html:
Staff Dashboard

Northwest Custom Apparel · Milton, Washington

Shop Menu

Est. 1977 · embroidery, sewing, DTF, finishing & laser, priced by the piece · 2026

$75 minimum per job
one hour of bench time — any service on this menu, one minimum per ticket · bill the difference on LTM

House Rules

  1. Bring us your goods, we price by the piece. Price × quantity, with a $75 minimum per job — bill the difference on LTM.
  2. Not on the menu? We quote the time: $25 per quarter hour at the bench (sewing, finishing, hand work) or $37.50 per quarter hour on a machine (embroidery heads, heat press, laser) — bench $100/h, machine $150/h; on DECG, DECC or Laser; Erik or Ruthie approves the estimate.
  3. Supplies we provide (transfers, labels, bags, special thread) are priced the same way as our garments — our cost ÷ 0.53, never a garment: $1 → $1.89 · $2 → $3.77 · $5 → $9.43 · $10 → $18.87. Goods you supply are worked at your risk. We supply the garment? Use the quote builder; names, patches and puff are add-ons there at the same prices.

Setting the table…

2025 Freeman Road East, Milton, WA 98354 · 253-922-5793 · sales@nwcustomapparel.com
